brandStory: Kove (KOVEMOTO) was founded in 2017 in Chongqing, China, and is a subsidiary of Tibet Summit Colove Motorcycle Sales Co., Ltd. The company develops, builds and sells mid-to-large capacity motorcycles, electric motorcycles and core components, including its own multi-cylinder engines. It holds more than 100 granted patents covering powertrain, chassis, electric and intelligent systems.

models.name: 800X Touring
models.tagline: 799 cc twin adventure tourer with heated seat, grips and cruise
summary: The Kove 800X Touring is the long-distance member of Kove's 799 cc twin-cylinder adventure family. It shares the 69.5 kW parallel twin and 1,520 mm wheelbase of the 800X Pro but adds a 19-inch front and 17-inch rear wheel pair, an 826 mm seat, a taller and wider screen and a 22-litre plastic tank mounted low in the frame.

It suits riders who want touring comfort with enough ground clearance for gravel and rough tracks. Heated grips and seat, cruise control, a bi-directional quickshifter, traction control, four riding modes and tyre-pressure monitoring all come as standard. Kerb weight is 195 kg, or 215 kg with the three-case set fitted, which keeps it manageable at low speed and when loaded.

models.name: 625X
models.tagline: Mid-size 581 cc twin adventure bike with rear radar and heated grips
summary: The Kove 625X is a mid-size adventure motorcycle built around a 581 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin with a 270° crankshaft, producing 46 kW and 56.5 Nm. It rolls on 19-inch front and 17-inch rear spoked tubeless wheels, carries a 21-litre tank and weighs 221 kg at the kerb, aimed at daily commuting, road touring and gravel riding.

Two versions are listed. The 625X PRO uses a 43 mm KYB fork and an adjustable KYB rear shock with an 820 or 850 mm seat. The 625X MAX adds electronic adaptive suspension that lowers the bike below 30 km/h and a dual dash camera. Both carry rear millimetre-wave radar with blind-spot, lane-change and rear-collision warnings, heated seat and grips, and keyless start.

models.tagline: 190 kg 799 cc adventure bike with 21-inch front and 240 mm KYB travel
summary: The Kove 800X Pro is an off-road focused adventure motorcycle that puts a 799 cc twin into a 190 kg package. The 69.5 kW engine sits in a chassis with a 21-inch front and 18-inch rear spoked wheel, 240 mm of KYB suspension travel at each end and 275 mm of ground clearance, for riders who spend real time on loose and rocky ground.

Weight is kept down with an aluminium swingarm, handlebar, footrest supports and spoked rims. Ride-by-wire with four riding modes, traction control, dual-channel ABS, a slipper clutch and a quickshifter come with cruise control, tyre-pressure monitoring and a 7-inch TFT with phone navigation projection, so the bike also works for long road stages between trails.

models.tagline: 176 kg twin-cylinder rally adventure bike with 270 mm fork travel
summary: The Kove 800X Rally takes the 799 cc twin from Kove's adventure range and builds a rally-style motorcycle around it. With 69.5 kW, 79 Nm and a kerb weight of 176 kg, it is the lightest of the 800X models, and its centrally placed 20-litre tank keeps fuel weight near the middle of the bike as it empties.

It is aimed at riders planning long trips that include hard off-road sections. A fully adjustable 49 mm dual-chamber fork with 270 mm of travel, a 240 mm rear shock with external reservoir, a 21-inch front wheel and 293 mm of ground clearance handle ruts and rocks. A mechanical throttle gives direct response on loose surfaces, and seat height is 890 mm.

summary: The Kove 450 Rally RE is the version of Kove's 450 rally machine fitted with lights and ABS, built for long distances on remote tracks. Its 449 cc liquid- and oil-cooled DOHC single drives through a six-speed gearbox with hydraulic clutch, and a 32-litre fuel capacity at 155 kg kerb weight lets riders cover long stretches between fuel stops.

A steel twin-spar frame, 21-inch front and 18-inch rear wheels, fully adjustable suspension, dual-channel ABS and a TFT display complete the package.

summary: The Kove 450RR is a full-fairing sports bike powered by a 443 cc inline-four that revs to 14,000 rpm and makes 49 kW at 13,250 rpm. Kove draws on its World Superbike paddock experience for the bike, which pairs the engine with a 7 kg steel trellis frame, a 1,385 mm wheelbase and a 165 kg kerb weight.

It suits track-day riders and buyers who want four-cylinder character in a light, compact bike. Fully adjustable KYB suspension, 300 mm twin front discs with four-piston calipers, dual-channel ABS, traction control, an upshift quickshifter, launch control and a steering damper come as standard. A beginner mode limits top speed to 140 km/h for the first 500 km.

summary: The Kove MX250 Cross R is a 250 cc motocross bike aimed at riders building skills and lap pace. Its 249.9 cc liquid-cooled DOHC four-valve single produces 30 kW at 12,000 rpm and 27 Nm at 9,500 rpm, with a five-speed gearbox and quickshifter, and the whole bike weighs 97 kg.

A fully adjustable KYB upside-down fork offers 310 mm of travel, and the fully adjustable rear shock 280 mm, to absorb braking bumps and landings. It runs 21-inch front and 19-inch rear wheels with 310 mm of ground clearance and a 960 mm seat. Selectable Sport and Eco modes help riders match power to conditions.

models.tagline: 578 cc V-twin cruiser with a 700 mm seat and 20-litre twin-tank layout
summary: The Kove 625V is a mid-size cruiser that borrows ideas from Kove's adventure bikes. Its 578.2 cc liquid-cooled DOHC V-twin with a balance shaft produces 38.5 kW and 52 Nm, and a main and auxiliary tank layout holds 20 litres, mounted towards the centre of the bike to keep the front end light.

With a 700 mm seat, rearward handlebar and 205 kg kerb weight, it suits newer riders and those who want a relaxed cruiser for town and longer trips. Riders from 165 cm to 185 cm are catered for with an adjustable handlebar and two-position footpegs. Dual-channel ABS, traction control, a slipper clutch and side-bag mounting points come as standard.
